nodes.description: Owned constructor: sets initial owner from msg.sender and emits OwnershipTransferred
Owned.proposeOwner(address payable _newOwner) external onlyOwner: proposes a new owner
Owned.claimOwnership() external: proposed owner claims ownership, rewrites owner
ERC20 constructor(string name_, string symbol_): sets _name and _symbol
ERC20.transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) public: transfers from _msgSender()
ERC20.allowance(address owner, address spender): returns stored allowance
ERC20.approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public: approves spender for _msgSender()
ERC20.transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) public: moves tokens using allowance
ERC20.increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public: adds to allowance
ERC20.decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) public: subtracts from allowance
ERC20._transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) internal virtual: core balance bookkeeping
ERC20._mint(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual: increases total supply and balance
ERC20._burn(address account, uint256 amount) internal virtual: decreases balance and total supply
ERC20._approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) internal virtual: writes allowance
ERC20._beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual hook: empty in base ERC20
BigBangToken constructor: sets minSupply, feesEnabled, mints total supply, seeds isExcludedFromFee and beneficiary
BigBangToken._transfer override: applies burn fee and beneficiary transfer fee when fees enabled
BigBangToken.burn(uint256 value) public: burns caller balance and enforces min supply
Owned.onlyOwner modifier: requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded body
Owned.owner: privileged address controlling admin functions
BigBangToken.minSupply: lower bound of total supply enforced during burns
BigBangToken.beneficiary: recipient of the 2% transfer fee
BigBangToken.feesEnabled: global switch of fee logic

BigBangToken._transfer: amount - transferFee - burnedFee net amount arithmetic
BigBangToken._transfer: totalSupply() - burnedFee >= minSupply supply-threshold arithmetic
BigBangToken.burn: require(totalSupply() >= minSupply) post-burn supply invariant check
